methodology: Deterministic rules over NASA records. A pair is comparable only if both are burn-relevant (not smoke/detection), have a recorded outcome, are the same material and report the SAME outcome variable in the SAME unit as printed (no conversion; LOI downward and MOC/ULOI upward are never mixed). Differences in gravity, O2 (beyond the configured tolerance), pressure, airflow, test procedure, material variant or source campaign are listed as limitations. Nothing is interpolated or inferred; missing values are reported as 'not stated'.
